BrochureContent.Content:
DNG Boyce Gallagher are delighted to present to market this impressive home, ideally located in the peaceful townland of Carrickmagrath.
Nestled within a small and exclusive development, the property enjoys far-reaching views over the surrounding countryside, offering an excellent balance of rural tranquillity and convenience. Situated just circa one mile from Ballybofey, the property benefits from easy access to local amenities, schools, and the wider Twin Towns area.

Internally, the accommodation is bright, spacious, and thoughtfully designed, with a layout that lends itself perfectly to modern family living. High-quality panelling and carefully considered detailing have already been incorporated throughout, providing a strong foundation for further finishing and personalisation.

The property is currently completed to builder’s finish, presenting a rare opportunity for the incoming purchaser to complete the home to their own taste and specification, without the time, cost, and uncertainty typically associated with a full new build project.

Extending to approximately 250 sq.m (2,691 sq.ft), the accommodation is both generous and well laid out, offering excellent flexibility for a growing family or those seeking additional space.

This is a superb opportunity to acquire a high-quality home with significant potential in a sought-after location. Viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate all that is on offer.

Some of the images used in the marketing of this property are AI-generated visualisations and are provided strictly for illustrative purposes only to help prospective purchasers envisage how the property may look upon completion.

The advertised price reflects the property on completion and includes a generous Prime Cost (PC) sum to allow for the final finishes and completion of works.
